preconditions.description: The length of the input string must be between 1 and 999.

postconditions.description: If the length of the input string is odd, the output should be a single character. If the length is even, the output should be two characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == str[len(str) // 2] if len(str) % 2 != 0 else return_value == str[len(str) // 2 - 1:len(str) // 2 + 1]
postconditions.description: If the length of the input string is odd, the output should be the middle character. If the length is even, the output should be the two middle characters.
